Back CoE contribution to UN Security Council High-level open debate “New and emerging technologies in the context of international peace and security”

The Council of Europe – in its capacity of the Permanent Observer to the UN – contributed to UN Security Council High-level open debate “New and emerging technologies in the context of international peace and security”, 24 November 2026.

Council of Europe statement was specifically devoted to the role of the CoE AI Framework Convention in supporting responsible AI governance.

You can watch the recording at the following link: Conflict resolution in an era of rapid technological change - Security Council, 10278th meeting (resumed) — UN Transcripts.
